newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hochtief up on renewed Holzmann speculation.
newsitem.headline: Hochtief up on renewed Holzmann speculation.

text.p: Shares in German builder Hochtief AG advanced strongly in pre-bourse trade on Monday on reports that it and Deutsche Bank wanted to pool their shares in the builder Holzmann.
Hochtief shares were up 2.25 marks, or 3.19 percent, at 72.75 marks in pre-bourse IBIS trade, compared to the overall IBIS DAX index which was up 24.85 marks, or 0.76 percent, at 3,313.37 points.
The Sueddeutsche Zeitung said a decision on the pooling of shares, which would need approval from European competition authorities, could come from Deutsche's supervisory board as soon as this week.

Deutsche and Hochtief, which has been seeking to acquire Holzmann for some time, would together have almost 50 percent of Holzmann shares. Deutsche owns 25.8 percent, while Hochtief has a 20 percent stake.

The aim of a pooling arrangement would be to allow Hochtief to extend its management influence over Holzmann. Deutsche last week rejected another report saying it planned to pool its shares with Hochtief.
